//: FRONTEND-BFF.md §7 — 'One package manager, one workspace, ALL apps members of it.
A mixed npm/pnpm monorepo is an anti-pattern with no upside.' The workspace exists
from the first commit even though it holds one app, because the anti-example in §7 is
a repo that scaffolded the apps first and never got the workspace: four apps, two in
pnpm, two on standalone npm with their own lockfiles, three CI setup blocks.
There is exactly ONE lockfile and it is next to this file, never inside app/.
The @ab-ovo/web-kit package of §7 is deliberately NOT here yet: the kit is what stops
two apps diverging, so it is created when the SECOND app arrives. Until then app/ is
the only copy of the BFF code and there is nothing for it to drift from.
name: ab-ovo-web-workspace
